issues.detail: The Hebrew says Hezekiah (וַיִּשְׁלַח, implied subject from context is Hezekiah) sent Eliakim, Shebna, and the elders to Isaiah. The Vietnamese says 'A-mốt sai' (Amoz sent), which is a name swap — Amoz is the father of Isaiah, not the sender. The subject of the verb is Hezekiah, not Amoz.
